text: I came here after seeing a review on TikTok and I'm very disappointed. The doctor was almost half an hour late, and the doctor I saw was very rude and lacked composure. When asked if I had any more questions, their facial expression and gaze were constantly fixed on the clock. The examination lasted less than five minutes, and they said I had to pay a deposit for an X-ray to check if my teeth were protruding or needed extraction, without even mentioning my dental problems beforehand. I had to ask to be told that the problems I asked about were minor. I don't know if they rushed the examination because they were late to see the next patient or not. A free examination followed by a decision – no payment required!🤣 Shouldn't they have informed me of my dental problems beforehand? Not suddenly asking me to book an X-ray. I thought, okay, at least I'd get an X-ray. When I made the appointment, I asked the counter for a digital copy of the X-ray film. They said to contact the admin later. When I contacted them, the clinic asked what I needed it for. When I said maybe for orthodontic consultations, the clinic disappeared for a moment and came back saying the doctor wouldn't provide it and I had to pay 1500 baht, but I could change doctors. This is completely different from what they initially said – just contact the admin! Are they expecting me to do this automatically? When I asked why the doctor, who had a 11:00 appointment, only got out of his car at almost 11:30, the counter staff said the doctor was probably stuck in traffic. Traffic at 11:00? Which road in the Rangsit area were you stuck on? You're late, but you're rushing to see patients like this...
